hook: A YouTuber wore AI glasses linked to Claude and *got a perfect score* on Korea's tax accountant exam
caption:
Korean tech YouTuber Techmong wore Rokid AI glasses linked to Claude and took the first round of this year's tax accountant exam.
He says it answered all 160 questions right in 49 minutes, a perfect 400. The glasses' own built-in AI had gotten many wrong.
It used past exam questions, not a real test room. Then the exam's real top scorer admitted he cheated with a hidden camera and AI.

Should exams ban every pair of glasses now?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.
